QuestInfo.name: [Omega Sector] Nolyfe's Second Request
QuestInfo.1: Nolyfe's second condition that you recover his stolen SpaceCoins. Collect 5 of them in Corridor 103.
QuestInfo.2:
Nolyfe asked you to recover some SpaceCoins he lost. You collected 10 in Corridor 103.

Nolyfe told you to go through the portal at the far right of Corridor 103.

item.0: They took 5 of my SpaceCoins! Please get them back.
